fr_html: Le PRESIDENT met aux voix le texte qu'il a lu et qui est basé sur la proposition de M. Hagerup et de M. Ricci-Busatti. Il ajoute qu'il est entendu que ce texte formera un vœu ou une déclaration séparée.
en_html: The PRESIDENT took a vote upon the draft which he had read and which was based on the propositions of M. Hagerup and M. Ricci-Busatti. He added that it was to be understood that this draft would constitute a resolution or a separate declaration.
